evidence:
Source review only; no container was started and no run exercised this row.

Workbook check 46: 'The agent can't read the criteria it's graded on or influence the reward - grading is isolated in the verifier.' Skill quality-checks.md:185: 'the agent image ships no criteria, no judge client, no RewardKit, and no readable copy of the rubric; grading is isolated in the verifier image.'

1. Agent image ships no grading material. task/environment/Dockerfile:9-12 installs only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1; lines 14-15 are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'. The build context (task/environment) holds only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md and instructions/integration.md. No COPY of tests/ or solution/, no claude-code, no playwright, no rewardkit. /app is created with only .gitkeep (lines 17-23). File is byte-identical to the frozen template.

2. No readable rubric copy in the agent's world. grep for 'hro_|criterion|rubric|rewardkit|/tests|/logs|/solution|/proc|judge' over task/environment/ and task/instruction.md returned zero hits; the same vocabulary has zero hits in seed_data.json. (Paraphrase-level overlap between brief and criteria is owned by rows 5/16, not judged here.)

3. Grading is isolated. task/task.toml:28 'environment_mode = "separate"'; only artifacts '/app' and '/assets' cross over (line 2). Judge CLI, Playwright MCP and harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 exist only in task/tests/Dockerfile:16-31. Criteria live only under tests/*/*/judge.toml, copied by tests/Dockerfile:43 'COPY . /tests'.

4. The submitted app cannot read criteria or write the reward at grading time, by source. tests/Dockerfile:44 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests'; test.sh:3 'umask 077', :11 'chmod 700 "$LOG_DIR"', :12 'chmod -R go-rwx /tests'; the app is launched at :104-111 with 'env -i' (only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH, so no ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) under 'setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups'. reward.txt/reward.json are written only by root in the 0700 log dir (test.sh:14-23, score.py:59-60). test.sh:72-83 refuses any symlink resolving outside /app/node_modules, so /app cannot alias /tests or /logs. The restart helper sits inside the 0700 log dir and restart_mcp.py:40 runs it with env={'PATH': SAFE_PATH}. score.py:10 reads policy from /tests/scoring.toml, unreachable by uid 65534.

5. Key handling. task.toml:34 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"' is a template, :35 empty ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; grep for 'sk-or-|sk-ant-|PRIVATE KEY' across the task: zero hits. The key exists only in [verifier.env] and is stripped from the app process by env -i.

6. solution/solve.sh writes only under /app (lines 3, 35-36) and refuses a DB path outside /app (5-9); nothing touches /tests, /logs/verifier or /solution. The golden server sources contain no reference to /tests, /logs, /proc, reward or provider keys.

7. All five prompts carry the untrusted-submission line and forbid shell/filesystem probes (e.g. gates/render/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:3), limiting reward influence through the judge (row 45 owns the depth of this).

Weak-app probe considered: an app that tries to read /tests/scored/functional/judge.toml or overwrite /logs/verifier/reward.txt at grading time is denied by the uid 65534 / 0700 / go-rwx controls above. Conforming-alternative probe: an app using node_modules symlinks inside /app/node_modules is still graded (test.sh:74-78), and integration.md:16-19 states that rule publicly, so the isolation control does not punish a conforming build.

Residual, unmeasured (reason for risk=true): (a) no runtime record in raw-evidence-index.json demonstrates that uid 65534 is actually denied on /tests and /logs/verifier inside the built verifier image; the index scope says full configured grading is absent. (b) The app shares the verifier container's PID namespace with the root judge; /proc/<pid>/cmdline is world-readable by default, so if rewardkit 0.1.7 passes the rendered prompt (which embeds {criteria}) as a claude-code argv, the running app could read criterion text during grading. rewardkit is not installed locally, so I could not read how it passes the prompt; this is unverified in either direction. It would not help the building agent, who never sees the verifier, and exploiting it needs an app that rewrites its behaviour from rubric text at runtime. It arises entirely in template-controlled test.sh/Dockerfile, byte-identical to the frozen template, so it is not a task-authoring defect and must not be patched in this task. (c) /assets is a mutable artifact, but nothing in test.sh reads it beyond chmod (line 88) and the brief says /assets is unavailable at runtime, so it gives no reward lever.
